Aarav Gill | aarav.gill164@example.com | +91 9542558935
Pune, Maharashtra

Professional Summary
Results-driven business development professional with a proven track record across high-growth consumer mobility and healthcare platforms. Skilled at building pipeline, negotiating enterprise contracts, and improving CRM-driven sales operations to accelerate revenue. Open to relocating to Chennai or Mumbai.

Technical Skills
B2B Sales, Salesforce, Lead Generation, CRM, Confluence, Linux

Work Experience

Senior Business Development Manager, Ola (Jul 2025 - Jun 2026)
- Led Lead Generation campaigns targeting corporate mobility programs, generating 420 qualified enterprise leads in 12 months using targeted outreach and partner co-marketing; tracked pipeline and conversion stages in Salesforce.
- Managed CRM hygiene and process improvements across regional sales teams, reducing data lag by 35% and improving follow-up rates through standardized CRM workflows.
- Closed strategic B2B Sales deals for employee commute programs with three mid-market accounts, contributing to a 22% uplift in regional ARR while maintaining contract templates and negotiation playbooks in Confluence.

Business Development Manager, Orbit Health (Feb 2024 - Jun 2025)
- Built and executed Lead Generation strategies for hospital and clinic partnerships, delivering a pipeline of 180 qualified institutional opportunities within the first year.
- Drove B2B Sales conversations with enterprise healthcare providers, leading contract negotiations and onboarding processes that resulted in a 15% increase in monthly revenue.
- Maintained CRM records to ensure seamless handoff between sales and implementation teams and documented playbooks in Confluence for repeatable outreach sequences.

Sales Manager, Infosys (Jan 2020 - Jan 2024)
- Directed Lead Generation initiatives for technology services targeting BFSI and retail verticals, generating over 1,200 marketing-qualified leads through event-based campaigns and outbound programs.
- Oversaw Salesforce-driven opportunity management, implementing reporting dashboards that improved forecast accuracy by 28% and accelerated deal cycle times.
- Managed CRM processes and cross-functional coordination for pre-sales and delivery teams, and authored standard operating procedures in Confluence to streamline bid responses.

Education
B.Sc Computer Science, St. Xavier's College
